context: Teach the shim the full 0.3.0 surface (two-level injection points, RO/RW token mapping, drafts-dir mapping for finding sync), refuse-with-message for verbs it cannot safely route, and add compat tests per verb.
description: todo_db_standalone_compat.py predates findings/update/doctor/init-project (written 2026-07-21). Two-level commands (finding X, audit verify) get --db/identity injected BETWEEN levels -> argparse usage error. Unknown verbs (finding sync/candidates, update, doctor) pass through unpinned: the standalone's default resolution then silently creates fork databases — a passthrough write can SUCCEED into a fresh empty DB at the archived .todo-db/todo.sqlite path (split-brain, writes lost). Also maps list/ready/stats to the standalone's READ_ONLY mode which demands TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN absent from BenchBox environments. Zero shim test coverage for any new verb. Until fixed, BENCHBOX_TODO_DB_STANDALONE=1 must be considered unsafe.

preserves.behavior: Legacy default path (no BENCHBOX_TODO_DB_STANDALONE) byte-identical behavior
